fg_spanning_tree.note: fg_spanning_tree G T: T is a set of edges of G (2-subsets of the carrier, subset of fg_edges G) whose labelled graph on the whole carrier of G is an upstream tree (unique irredundant paths and connected); isolated vertices of G count, so they exclude any spanning tree when G has two or more vertices; no nonempty guard.

fg_spanning_treeb.note: fg_spanning_treeb G T: the Boolean [T \subset fg_edges G && is_forestb _ && connectedb _], reflected by fg_spanning_treeP.

spanning_connected_edge_set.note: spanning_connected_edge_set G T: every two HOST vertices are joined by an undirected uwalk using only edges of T (reference orientation immaterial); an isolated host vertex excludes it; no nonempty or loopless premise.

spanning_tree_edge_set.note: spanning_tree_edge_set G T: spanning-connected and without circuits inside T (acyclic_edge_set); a selected loop or two selected parallel edges are circuits; edges outside T are unconstrained.
